name: Break Brainrot Bones
desc:
💥 Welcome to Break Brainrot Bones! 💥
Fly through the air as crazy brainrots and smash as many bones as possible! 🦴
The more bones you break, the more money you earn! 💰

Use your cash to:
⚡ Buy powerful upgrades for your brainrots
🧠 Unlock stronger and funnier brainrots
⬇️ Reach higher levels to fall from even greater heights!

Can you break the most bones and become the ultimate brainrot legend? 🔥
